title: I'M LOOKING THROUGH A LOOKING GLASS

lines.text: Im looking through a looking glass,
Ill tell you what I see,
The people of the Lord are as perfect as can be
Im looking through the Blood of God.
And this is what I see,
The people of the Lord are as perfect as can be.
Oh! praise the Lord,
Its Jesus that I see,
The Bright and Morning Star,
Revealed in you and me,
Oh I thank God,
Im a part of that family
Where the people are as perfect as can be.
Dont speak evil of your brother,
Lest you speak against the Lord,
For the Lord you know is perfect
Without a single flaw.
As long as hes repenting
For the sin that he can see;
Your brother is as perfect,
As perfect as can be.
Lets go on unto perfection,
Though we are potentially,
Till Christ be formed within us,
And our promises believe.
Till our bodies are translated,
Right into the heavenlies
Where the people of the Lord
Are as perfect as can be.
